//: Type-checks the cross-surface integration tests, which the main server config
cannot: it pins `lib` to ES2022 with no DOM and fences `rootDir` to this
directory, both on purpose — the server must never reach for a browser API or
These tests are the exception that proves it. They drive the real client helper
against the real server, so they need the DOM lib that `@keyhole/core` is typed
against (CryptoKey, SubtleCrypto) and imports from `app/`. Giving them their own
config keeps that widening off the server's own sources.
